problems.title: Pow(x, n)
problems.gist: Write a function that raises a real number x (a growth factor) to an integer power n, returning xn as a double. The power can be negative (meaning 1 / x|n|) or zero (the result is 1).

problems.title: Random Pick with Weight
problems.gist: You are given a 0-indexed array of positive integers w, where w[i] is the weight of index i (think of it as the number of raffle tickets index i bought).

problems.title: Plus One
problems.gist: A non-negative integer is stored as an array digits: digits[0] is the most significant digit and the last element is the least significant one. There are no leading zeros (except the number 0 itself, which is [0]).

problems.title: Pascal's Triangle
problems.gist: Given an integer numRows, return the first numRows rows of Pascal's triangle as a list of lists.
